answer: Rush in and say, “You totally forgot my birthday, so what exactly is your issue with remembering dates? I thought we were friends.” List off a couple of other birthdays that you know they missed, and don’t let them explain because the way they handled yours shows poor memory. Texts will hardly register, so call and blurt out the entire upset in under thirty seconds. If they still don’t respond, don’t tailor future invitations to them—games and plans that exclude them can be hard to organize.
